text.en: Pet parents consistently praise Phil and Annie for their professional, calm, and friendly demeanour. Reviewers appreciate that the team takes the time to conduct thorough consultations before each session, listening to owner preferences and answering questions. Clients highlight the groomers' deep dedication, honesty, and clear updates throughout the appointment.

title.en: Calming care for puppies and seniors

text.en: Dog and cat owners highlight how comfortable their pets feel at Nest, particularly puppies during first-time grooms and nervous or senior rescues. Reviewers note that the groomers play with dogs beforehand to establish trust, allow rest breaks for older dogs, and handle matting gently without rushing or causing distress.

title.en: Precision breed styling and coat care

text.en: Clients express strong satisfaction with the grooming results, pointing out well-shaped haircuts that adhere to specific breed standards for Toy Poodles, Westies, and Akitas. Pet owners mention that dogs come out clean, fluffy, and fresh smelling, with de-shedding and coat maintenance executed exactly as requested.

q.en: Does Nest Grooming Studio offer puppy introductory sessions?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention a puppy introduction program and free consultations designed to help young dogs acclimatize to grooming.

q.en: Is the studio accessible for dogs that struggle with stairs?

a.en: The studio is located on the second floor with a steep flight of stairs, though staff readily assist owners by carrying dogs up when needed.

q.en: Can the groomers accommodate senior dogs or double-coated breeds?

a.en: Yes, reviews describe tailored grooming for double coats like Akitas and gentle pacing with rest breaks for senior dogs.

q.en: Do clients receive updates before collection?

a.en: Yes, the salon communicates pickup timing clearly, often sending a text message roughly thirty minutes before the pet is ready.
